lines.text: Many learners say: What means this word?
Better: What does this word mean?
The first! What does this word mean?

native.tip: Em português dizemos “O que significa?”, direto; em inglês, a pergunta pede “does” antes de “this word”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “What means this word?” O certo é “What does this word mean?” Em português dizemos “O que significa?”, direto; em inglês, a pergunta pede “does” antes de “this word”. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.

en.tip: In Portuguese we say “O que significa?”, directly; in English, the question needs “does” before “this word”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “What means this word?” The right way is “What does this word mean?” In Portuguese we say “O que significa?”, directly; in English, the question needs “does” before “this word”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
